rationale.A: 150 m on Aleksis Kiven katu with tram rails and 100 m on Helsinginkatu in traffic, then Töölönlahti
rationale.B: Same as A but via Viipurinkatu tram street (180 m) instead
rationale.C: Tivolitie, paths past Helsinginkatu and Töölönlahti to Baana; no mixed traffic; +1 min
rationale.D: Viipurinkatu tram stretch, then Linnunlaulu bridge and Töölönlahti; 1 light, +2 min
rationale.E: Via the Olympic stadium area and Töölönlahti; no traffic, one more unsignalled crossing; +2 min
rationale.F: Eläintarha path, Kaisaniemi park, Kaisantunneli and Baana; least side path, 1 light, +3 min
rationale.G: Porvoonkatu tram and Kallio/Siltasaari side tracks; 7 lights
rationale.H: Path beside Aleksis Kiven katu then Töölönlahti; no traffic but longest; +5 min

notes: Calm: C removes A's tram-rail and Helsinginkatu carriageway stretches for +1 min. F is marginally calmer but not worth 2 more minutes. Fewest lights: D saves 2 lights for 2 min (1 min/light). F does the same for +3.
